preamble: This checkout has no installed dependencies: do not install any. TypeScript files run directly with `node`. Nobody can answer questions during this task, so decide and finish. Give your complete answer in your last message.

tasks.prompt: By default, after how many model requests is a subagent asked to wrap up, and after how many is it stopped outright? Give both numbers and the source file that defines them.

reference.answer: Soft limit 160, hard stop at 240 (160 x 1.5), both in packages/coding-agent/src/octocode/subagents/budget.ts.
wrong: Soft limit 100, hard stop at 150, in packages/coding-agent/src/octocode/subagents/budget.ts.
It wraps up at 160 and stops at 240; see subagents/model.ts.

tasks.prompt: When the cost of a model request is calculated, how are 1-hour and 12-hour prompt-cache writes priced relative to the input rate, and which token counts are added up to pick a context price tier? Give the multipliers and the source file.

reference.answer: In packages/ai/src/models/model-helpers.ts, 1-hour writes cost 2x the input rate and 12-hour writes 2.5x. The tier is picked from input + cacheRead + cacheWrite.
wrong: In packages/ai/src/models/model-helpers.ts, cache writes all cost 1.25x the input rate; only input tokens pick the tier.
1-hour writes cost 2x and 12-hour writes 2.5x of input, from input + cacheRead + cacheWrite, in core/cache-stats.ts.

tasks.prompt: In headless print mode (`octocode -p "..."`, text output), which assistant stop reasons make the process exit with code 1? List them and name the source file.

reference.answer: packages/coding-agent/src/modes/print-mode.ts exits 1 for stop reasons error, aborted and, in text mode, length.
wrong: packages/coding-agent/src/modes/print-mode.ts exits 1 for stop reasons error and aborted only.

wrong: core/cache-warmer.ts, core/cache-stats.ts, model-selector/details.ts, shared/util.ts, subagents/model.ts and subagents/budget.ts.

tasks.prompt: From the lockfile: which versions of `marked` does this repository resolve, and which package needs the older one? What package and version does coding-agent's `highlight.js-browser` dependency really install?

reference.answer: marked resolves to 18.1.1 for the workspaces and 16.4.2 for mermaid (mermaid@12.2.0 asks for ^16.3.0). highlight.js-browser is an alias of highlight.js 11.12.0.
wrong: marked resolves only to 18.1.1, used by the workspaces. highlight.js-browser is highlight.js 11.12.0.
marked resolves to 18.1.1 and 16.4.2, the older one for mermaid. highlight.js-browser is highlight.js 10.7.3.

Give the tier's name, the default thinking level and the environment variable that changes it, the range of shares of the parent's price that tier's candidates must fall in, and the source file that defines them.

reference.answer: The medium tier at medium thinking (OCTOCODE_SUBAGENT_THINKING changes it); candidates cost 0.15 to 0.8 of the parent's price. See packages/coding-agent/src/octocode/subagents/model.ts.
wrong: It inherits the parent's model at the parent's thinking level; subagents/model.ts.
The small tier at low thinking (OCTOCODE_SUBAGENT_THINKING changes it), 0.05 to 0.5 of the parent's price; subagents/model.ts.
